mapper.select: select mn.Mear_Upper_Amount, mn.Mear_Upper_Total, mn.Mear_Cumulative_Amount, mn.Mear_Cumulative_Total from Con_Measure_Record mn left join Con_Measure cm on cm.Id = mn.Mea_Id where cm.Con_Id = #{conId} and mn.Mear_Boqd_Code = #{boqdCode} and cm.State = 7 order by cm.State_Time desc limit 1

select mn.Mear_Boqd_Code, mn.Mear_Cumulative_Amount, mn.Mear_Cumulative_Total from Con_Measure_Record mn left join Con_Measure cm on cm.Id = mn.Mea_Id where cm.Con_Id = #{conId} and cm.State = 7 order by cm.State_Time desc
select mn.* from Con_Measure_Record mn left join Con_Measure cm on cm.id = mn.Mea_Id where cm.Con_Id = #{conId} and mn.Mear_Boqd_Code = #{boqdCode} and cm.State = 7 order by cm.State_Time desc
